system_overview: This specification is a TLA+ script that orchestrates the statistical analysis of EWD998 algorithm variants by forking multiple nested TLC instances. It systematically runs TLC in generator mode for every combination of feature flags (subsets of pt1 through pt5) and node counts (7, 29, 43), collecting performance statistics into a single CSV file for subsequent analysis with R.
actors_and_components: The module acts as a test harness that iterates over all combinations of algorithm variants and ring sizes. For each combination, it launches a nested TLC process running the EWD998_opts specification with the appropriate parameters, captures the exit code, and logs results.
model_bounds: The script tests all subsets of the five feature flags across three node counts (7, 29, 43), resulting in 32 x 3 = 96 TLC invocations. Each nested TLC instance generates 10 traces.
additional_assumptions: Requires TLC, IOUtils, CSV, and Sequences modules. The script uses ASSUME statements to perform computation at TLC startup time. Each nested TLC instance is configured with the appropriate feature flags and node count via environment variables. Exit codes are interpreted as success (0), assumption violation (10), safety violation (12), or liveness violation (13).
